name: Pintu Pohan
quote: Behind the counter of a tiny neighborhood paan shop sits Pintu Pohan, quietly crafting 11 novels, hundreds of stories, and countless poems between serving customers.
attribution: — Pintu Pohan, paan shop owner & writer, Behala

name: Kake di Hatti & Balwan Singh's Eating House
quote: From legendary bites at Kake Di Hatti and late-night chai at Balwant Singh Dhaba to neighbors crowning it 'Netaji Para', every corner carries a distinct pride and flavor.
attribution: — Kake di Hatti & Balwant Singh's Eating House, Bhawanipore

name: Bhaskar Chitrakar
quote: Carrying forward four generations of artistic lineage, 48-year-old Bhaskar Chitrakar keeps the timeless heritage of traditional Kalighat Patachitra scroll painting alive in the heart of Patuapara.
